Driving Licence Check Online Punjab: DLIMS Status and Renewal

How to check your driving licence status online in Punjab through DLIMS at dlims.punjab.gov.pk, book a test or renewal, and prepare the documents you need.

Photo: Jim Peaco, Yellowstone National Park · Public domain · source

Short answer: You can check your driving licence status online in Punjab on the DLIMS portal at dlims.punjab.gov.pk. The same portal handles learner permits, test and renewal appointments. Always check your licence number and CNIC details on the official website before you visit a licence office.

What DLIMS is

DLIMS is the Driving Licence Issuance and Management System used by the Punjab government. It keeps the record of learner permits and full licences, manages appointments for the theory and practical tests, and processes renewals. Because all offices in the province connect to it, the status you see online is the same record the office sees.

Check your licence status

  1. Open https://dlims.punjab.gov.pk in your browser.
  2. Choose the option to check licence status or verify a licence.
  3. Enter your CNIC number or the licence number exactly as printed.
  4. Complete the captcha if asked.
  5. Review the licence category, issue date and validity.

If the status shows "not found", check for a typing error first. A brand-new licence may take a little time to appear, and a licence issued in another province will not show in the Punjab system.

Renewing a licence

Driving licences expire and must be renewed. The renewal process normally needs your CNIC, the old licence and a fresh medical certificate for certain categories. You may be able to start the renewal online and visit the office only for the parts that need a physical check. Keep in mind that:

  • A learner permit is a temporary stage, not a full licence.
  • Renewal fees depend on the licence category and validity period.
  • An expired licence should be renewed before you drive again.

Book a test or appointment

DLIMS lets you book appointments for the learner test and other steps. Book early, because popular centres fill up. Carry the printed appointment slip and the original CNIC to the centre. Reach on time; a missed slot may need a new booking.

Documents and photos

Prepare clear copies of your CNIC and, where required, proof of residence and a medical certificate. Photographs must match the portal's size and background rules. A blurred scan is one of the most common reasons an application is turned back at the counter. Wafa Smart Tech (wafasmart.tech) offers free browser tools to crop a photo, change its size and compress it so it meets the portal's requirements before you upload.

Common problems

  • Name or CNIC mismatch between the application and NADRA records.
  • Uploading an oversized or low-quality photo.
  • Trying to check a licence issued by another province's authority on DLIMS.
  • Ignoring an expired learner permit and expecting a full licence.

If you recently passed a test, give the system a few days to update before you assume there is a problem. When you visit the office, carry the same documents you used online so the counter staff can match your record quickly.

Licence categories and international permits

Punjab issues licences for different vehicle categories, from motorcycle and car to heavier vehicles. Each category has its own test and fee, and a licence is valid only for the category it names. Driving a vehicle outside your category is treated as driving without the correct licence.

  • Apply for the category that matches the vehicle you will drive.
  • Complete the learner stage before booking the practical test.
  • Check the expiry date and renew before it lapses.
  • For travel abroad, ask about an international driving permit through the official authority.

Requirements and fees are revised periodically, so read the current rules on the official DLIMS site rather than relying on an old checklist.

Avoid agents and scams

There is no need to pay a middleman to "get" a licence, and anyone offering a licence without a test is breaking the law. Do not hand over your CNIC, original documents or money to a person outside the official counter, and never pay through a personal account. Use only dlims.punjab.gov.pk and official offices. Rules, fees and categories change, so verify every detail on the official portal before you apply.

Frequently asked questions

How can I check my driving licence status in Punjab?
Go to dlims.punjab.gov.pk and use the licence status or verification option. Enter your CNIC or licence number exactly as printed and complete the captcha if one appears.
Can I renew my driving licence online in Punjab?
DLIMS supports online steps for renewal, but some parts still need an office visit. Confirm the current process and fees on the official portal, and book any required appointment in advance.
Why does DLIMS show my licence as not found?
Often it is a typing error, or the licence is very new and not yet posted. A licence from another province will not appear in the Punjab system. Verify the details and try again later.
Do I need an agent to get a driving licence?
No. Applying directly is normal and safer. Anyone offering a licence without a test is committing fraud. Never share your CNIC or pay a personal account.
